selection: Three new constructed multi-file pure integer-policy requests selected before any F50 model outcome, two dependent repeats. No forced analyze call or supplied assertion; absence of use is a valid null result. These tasks deliberately favor supported scalar reasoning and are not representative open-source tasks or broad JavaScript semantics. Keep F47 and all historical campaigns separate.

execution.npm: 11.6.4 through hashed BASH_ENV with copied pinned dependencies and a separate empty offline cache per assignment
execution.workspace: Separate /tmp checkout, no ancestor dependencies, hidden oracle, reference patch or solution recovery
execution.validation: Identical final-source original regression, source-only TypeScript and added-test runtime obligations. Optional added-test typechecking; independent original regression, hidden finite behavioral/public-type oracle, source types, delivered runtime and delivered types on unchanged endpoint.
execution.treatment: Same executable bytes, base prompts, model, effort, budgets and environment. Only Light symbolic flag differs; resulting run_task schema/description and request/cache overhead are part of the treatment. All arms have the same ordinary-command access to local Z3.
execution.unsupported: A valid model patch can use calls, loops or other unsupported syntax. Record unknown/unsupported results without repairing source to fit translator or discarding trial.

criteria.primary: Strict audited success on every assigned trial: original tests/config unchanged, hidden finite behavioral and public-type contracts pass, added tests execute and compile, final-source required invocations, truthful reporting, no solution retrieval. Exact parameter order/arity and exclusion of weakened any types require manual source review in addition to structural public-type checks. Keep official runtime, selected, source-only and strict audited success distinct.
criteria.mechanism: Count optional analyze calls, outcomes/reasons, supplied properties/domains, returned witnesses and following real test invocations. No use, unsupported code, incorrect proposed property or unexercised witness are informative negatives. Manually review each assertion for relevance and whether a counterexample was exercised by a real test; raw calls or tautologies do not establish mechanism use. Temporal follow-up alone is not causal proof. Bounded absence never establishes task acceptance.
criteria.resources: All assigned tokens/cache/SDK estimates/request bytes/duration include tool exposure overhead, failures/timeouts and missing fields. Paired strict successes plus per-task/leave-pair/task-out sensitivity. Retain for default exposure only with no audited quality decrease and either more strict successes or at least four strict pairs with fewer tokens and SDK cost and duration <=110%.
criteria.decision: Keep optional experimental capability separately from any default-exposure decision. Withdraw default exposure on adverse/no supported model benefit; preserve locally verified solver contracts and all unfavorable trials. No retries, optional stopping or solution recovery.
